action.description: Action to perform. 'image_to_text' OCRs a single image. 'pdf_to_images' rasterizes a PDF into pages using Poppler CLI.

path.description: Absolute local path to the image file (png/jpg/webp/gif/tiff/bmp) or PDF. For image_to_text with a PDF, the tool returns a structured hint instead of OCR-ing it.

provider.description: Vision model provider (e.g. 'sarvam.ai/v2'). Must exist in bs-ai-models.json providers and support vision.

model.description: Vision model name (e.g. 'gemma4'). Must exist under the chosen provider with supports_vision: true.

prompt.description: Optional custom extraction instruction. Defaults to the built-in OCR prompt.

output_dir.description: Optional output directory. For image_to_text: where the .txt file goes. For pdf_to_images: where page images are written. Defaults to smart conventions per action.

dpi.description: Rasterization DPI for pdf_to_images. Forwarded to pdftoppm -r. Ignored for image_to_text.

first_page.description: First page number (1-indexed) for pdf_to_images. Defaults to 1.

last_page.description: Last page number for pdf_to_images. Defaults to all pages, capped by poppler.max_pages.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for image_to_text vision call. Defaults to model's max.
